title: Italy Squeezes Banks and Energy Firms as Growth Falters and Confidence Fades · 08 Sep
keywords: Italy, fiscal policy, bank taxation, energy sector, GDP growth, inflation, business confidence, eurozone, public finances, economic outlook, budget, Bank of Italy
notes: Italy's government is pressing banks and energy companies to advance tax payments in a bid to shore up public finances without resorting to a broad-based tax hike. The move comes as the economy posts only modest growth, business confidence deteriorates, and consumer prices continue to rise. The combination raises uncomfortable questions about whether Rome can sustain fiscal discipline without choking off investment and household spending power.
